text:
mike: FYI deployed audit-events schema v2 to staging for testing. It adds actor_roles, kms_key_id, and audit_version. Need docs, changelog, and a customer validation tool. Observability shows new fields flowing.

june: On it. Can you paste the canonical schema + a couple example events?

mike: here's the minimal canonical example (v2):
```
{
  "audit_version": "v2",
  "event_type": "access_granted",
  "timestamp": "2024-11-15T18:23:12Z",
  "request_id": "req_01G...",
  "actor": {"user_id": "u-123","user_email": "alice@acme.com","actor_roles": ["admin","deploy"]},
  "resource": {"type": "model","id": "redwood/gpt-3.1"},
  "action": "model.deploy",
  "outcome": "success",
  "kms_key_id": "projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/rw/cryptoKeys/key-01",
  "details": {"batch_size": 16}
}
```

oliver: I'll update quickstart + Postman collection. Do we want a short "what changed" section in the changelog highlighting fields customers should care about? :thinking_face:

taylor: Yes. Also plan compatibility: API will accept v1 payloads for 30 days and map to v2 in platform. Need a flag for strict validation. I'll open the feature flag PR.

sam: Support will draft a customer notice and SOC2-friendly note. Recommend we offer a validation endpoint or CLI so customers can validate archived audit logs before upgrade.

devsec-bot: Automated check: schema diff PR requires security review. SCA scan for new deps shows none.

june: For the changelog, can you provide a bulletized list of breaking vs additive changes?

mike: Additive: kms_key_id, audit_version, actor_roles. Breaking: timestamp now required ISO8601, event_type enumerations tightened (see list below). We will accept old event_type values via compatibility layer for 30 days.

mike: Allowed event_type values (initial): access_granted, access_revoked, config_change, secret_rotate, key_create, key_delete, model_deploy, model_rollback.

oliver: I created a draft PR to docs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789

taylor: PR for compatibility layer: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4567

sam: Drafted support email + FAQ skeleton; will share in a Google doc: https://docs.google.com/draft

june: Timeline? We need docs + changelog + validation tool published before we flip strict validation.

mike: Target: docs + changelog + validator CLI by EOD Friday. Compatibility flag off in two weeks. If any blockers call me.

oliver: Got it. I'll add examples for JS/Python and include sample curl validator.

sam: I'll prep a short customer advisory and triage plan for incoming tickets.

mike: Thanks everyone. Please add any follow-ups here. :thumbsup:
